# Copilot Instructions — mindbody-laravel

A Laravel package that wraps the MINDBODY Public API v6. Most of `src/Api/` and `src/Model/` is **auto-generated** by Swagger Codegen from `mindbody.json` — do not edit those files by hand.

## Commands

```bash
# Run all tests
./vendor/bin/phpunit

# Run a single test
./vendor/bin/phpunit --filter TestName

# Static analysis (level 8)
./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse

# Code style fix
./vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix
```

## Architecture

### Entry points
- `Mindbody` (`src/Mindbody.php`) — the core class. Acts as a dispatcher via `__call` magic.
- `MBO` (`src/MBO.php`) — a Laravel Facade backed by `Mindbody`.
- `MindbodyServiceProvider` registers `Mindbody` as a singleton and publishes `config/mindbody.php`.

### Method dispatch (`ProvidesMethodToEndpointMap` trait)
Every API method is available under two names:
- Full form: `{endpoint}{MethodName}` → e.g. `appointmentAddAppointment`
- Short form: `{MethodName}` → e.g. `AddAppointment`

The trait uses reflection at construction time to build a static `$methodToEndpointMap` array mapping both names to the appropriate `*Api` instance.

### API endpoints (`src/Api/`)
One class per domain: `AppointmentApi`, `ClassApi`, `ClientApi`, `EnrollmentApi`, `PayrollApi`, `PricingOptionApi`, `SaleApi`, `SiteApi`, `StaffApi`, `UserTokenApi`. All implement `ApiInterface`. These are **generated** — do not edit manually.

### Auth token (`ProvidesMindbodyAuthorisationToken` trait)
The MINDBODY user token is fetched via `UserTokenApi` and cached in Laravel Cache under key `MBO_Auth_Token_Key` for 23 hours. On a 401 "Token expired" / "Invalid user token" response, `__call` automatically clears the cache and retries once.

### Models (`src/Model/`)
All models extend `BaseModel` (handwritten, in the same file as `_BaseModel`). Models that have `getId(): int` implement `ModelWithIntId`; those returning `string` implement `ModelWithStringId`. This tagging is applied by `update.sh` via `sed`. The `container` array is the internal store; access is via generated getters/setters or `__get`/`__set`.

### Auditing
When `mindbody.audit` is true, every API call appends a CSV line `{timestamp},{methodName}` to `mboaudit.csv` via Laravel's `local` disk Storage.

## Configuration

Publish config: `php artisan vendor:publish --provider="Nlocascio\Mindbody\MindbodyServiceProvider"`

| Env var | Config key | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `MINDBODY_APIKEY` | `mindbody.apikey` | MINDBODY API key |
| `MINDBODY_SITEIDS` | `mindbody.site_id` | Site ID(s) |
| `MINDBODY_SOURCENAME` | `mindbody.source_name` | Source credentials username (also prefixed with `_`) |
| `MINDBODY_SOURCEPASSWORD` | `mindbody.source_credentials.password` | Source credentials password |
| `MINDBODY_DEBUG` | `mindbody.debug` | Enable Guzzle debug output |
| `MINDBODY_AUDIT` | `mindbody.audit` | Enable audit CSV logging |

## Updating the API

When MINDBODY releases API changes, follow `UPDATING.md`:
1. Run `php preprocessApi.php` to refresh `mindbody.json`
2. Run `update.sh` (wraps `swagger-codegen-cli.jar`) to regenerate `src/Api/` and `src/Model/`
3. Delete `src/test/` directory generated by Codegen
4. Run `Mindbody::getEndpointMethodSignatures()` and paste output into the `@method` PHPDoc blocks at the top of both `Mindbody.php` and `MBO.php`

## Testing

Tests use Orchestra Testbench. Integration tests require a `.env` file in the repo root with `MINDBODY_SITEIDS`, `MINDBODY_SOURCENAME`, and `MINDBODY_SOURCEPASSWORD`. Unit tests work without credentials.

## Code style

- PSR-2 base, enforced by PHP CS Fixer (`~3`) via `.php_cs`
- Short array syntax, ordered imports, strict comparison, strict params
- PHPStan level 8; `src/ObjectSerializer.php` is excluded; `is_null()` warnings suppressed in `src/Model/`
